thread:
incident-bot: ALERT: prism7b RPM spike in us-east-1 detected. p95 latency ↑30%, error rate ↑2.5% over baseline. Auto-scaling lagging. Metrics: https://metrics.redwood.example/prism7b/overview :rotating_light:
anya_oncall: I'm on it, grabbing logs and load distribution. @deepak_sre can you confirm whether KV cache hit rates dropped?
maria_g: seeing huge short-lived fanout from 3 API keys, looks like chat sessions got stuck and are retrying.
deepak_sre: KV hit steady, but effective tokens/sec doubled. Top callers: acme-pay (40%), microforms (25%), internal-qa (15%). We are saturating the small GPU pool for prism7b.
anya_oncall: plan: apply temporary TPM cap for prism7b to curb bursts, keep RPM soft for graceful degradation. Thinking TPM 120 -> 40 for 20m, re-evaluate. Also disable function-calling for prism7b to reduce expensive steps. Thoughts? :thinking_face:
jordan_prod: acme-pay has active customers, we should carve out enterprise customers if possible. Are there reserved capacity rules?
deepak_sre: enterprise carveout requires reserved capacity approval (not possible fast). Instead we can add a tenant-exempt list for top 2 enterprise keys via runtime ACL while global TPM applies. I'll prep the ACL.
maria_g: are we comfortable with disabling funcall? it will change responses for many apps.
anya_oncall: disable funcall only on prism7b non-enterprise route. Keep enterprise keys untouched via ACL. Execute steps now.
ops-bot: /run mitigation set-tpm --model prism7b --value 40 --duration 20m --reason "p95 latency surge"
ops-bot: command accepted, executing in 3 regions: us-east-1, us-west-2, eu-west-1. Rolling change starting now.
ops-bot: /run config set-feature --model prism7b --feature function_calling --state disabled --scope non-enterprise --reason "runtime cost spike"
Applying config to route: /models/prism7b/non-enterprise
ops-bot: done. TPM set to 40 in us-east-1, us-west-2, eu-west-1. Function-calling disabled for non-enterprise routes. Monitoring will report back in 60s.
maria_g: seeing immediate drop in tail latency, error rate trending down. acme-pay traffic unaffected (verified via ACL).
deepak_sre: KV cache warms back after 90s, throughput stable. No new 5xx spikes.
anya_oncall: good. I'll keep this thread active for the 20m window and hand off to @jordan_prod for 30m checks. Please post any customer escalations here.
jordan_prod: taking post-mitigation watch. Will coordinate with support and send targeted messages to acme-pay and top affected tenants to confirm behavior.
anya_oncall: filing a short incident note and will open follow-up ticket for root cause (likely retry storm + lack of circuit breaker on certain SDKs).
incident-bot: NOTE: mitigation window ends at +20m from 4689012345. Auto-revert scheduled unless extended.
anya_oncall: thanks team. If things stay stable, I'll revert TPM to previous value after 20m and re-enable function-calling for non-enterprise.
jordan_prod: acknowledged — will escalate to on-call MGR if customer reports.
ops-bot: mitigation auto-revert scheduled: /run mitigation revert --id 4689012345 --at 4689013465
anya_oncall: handing off. end of shift in 25m, tagging follow-up owner @deepak_sre for RCA. :white_check_mark:
